**Actor:** ShinyHunters
ShinyHunters claims to have stolen data from Charter Communications, allegedly including over 42 million customer records and customer proprietary network information (CPNI). HaveIBeenPwned analysis identified 4.9 million unique email addresses along with names, addresses, and phone numbers. Charter stated that only sales tools were impacted and that no CPNI or sensitive personal information was released by the threat actor. The group published the data on its Tor-based leak site on Thursday.
